metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins for development workflows

plugins.name: gtr
plugins.description: Git worktree management using git-worktree-runner for parallel branch development

plugins.name: telegram-notifier
plugins.description: Telegram notifications for Claude Code sessions - send messages manually or automatically after periods of inactivity

plugins.name: explain-changes
plugins.description: Explains code changes in detail - what was done and why. Uses explanatory style with educational insights.

plugins.name: plan-renamer
plugins.description: Rename plan files from random names to meaningful titles extracted from content

plugins.name: claudemd-gen
plugins.description: Interactive CLAUDE.md generator and auditor - encodes best practices for writing effective Claude Code memory files

plugins.name: prompt-clock
plugins.description: Send time on each typed prompt and start → end times on each turn's duration line

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: A side pane with the session's subagents, background shells and worktrees, with alerts when they finish or fail

plugins.name: codex-review
plugins.description: Codex reviews as background jobs with findings to pick and send to Claude, and a CodexReview tool

plugins.name: continuity
plugins.description: Live context gauge, session length and prompt-cache countdown; handover note, compaction and continue past a threshold; resume after a usage limit
